title: Awaze - Owner App
description: As a member of the Owner team, I contributed to developing and maintaining the Awaze Owner App, a cross-platform application for rental property owners. My work included implementing responsive client-side features aligned with design specifications, creating reusable components, shaping the frontend architecture (Clean Architecture), integrating Node.js APIs, and using Firebase Remote Config for feature updates. I also worked on performance improvements and helped identify and handle edge cases to keep the user experience reliable and consistent.

title: ITU - Zeeguu
description: Contributed to the front‑end development of the Zeeguu language learning platform, with a focus on accessibility enhancements, responsive UI components, intuitive onboarding flows, and overall user interface improvements. Optimized front‑end performance while refining a mobile‑first, component‑based architecture to enhance scalability, visual consistency, and user experience.

title: Opeepl - Website Design
description: Contributed to the full redesign of the Opeepl.com website with its subpages, focusing on creating a clean, mobile‑friendly UI layout aligned with the brand's visual style guide. Designed and delivered modular Figma mockups optimized for seamless integration with the Squarespace templates, allowing faster content updates and easier maintenance. Created static and animated visual assets, including illustrations and animations, to improve visual storytelling and strengthen brand presence.
